name: Prince Pipes and Fittings Ltd
title: Prince Pipes and Fittings Ltd - 542907 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 volume +23% and EBITDA margin 13% came from price pass-through of inventory gains and no Q4 inventory loss; April destocking and 52% utilisation argue against a clean cycle turn.

capex.quote: And the capex, which you asked about FY '27 plan, it will be in the range of INR200 crores

triggers.label: Inventory days 65-75 guided
triggers.quote: we have guided for 65 days to 75 days of inventory. And we are in that range as we speak.

triggers.label: Smaller players struggling, consolidation
triggers.quote: small players were struggling because of the large inventory losses and subdued demand environment

triggers.label: Margin guide 11-13% full year
triggers.quote: EBITDA should be closer to our normal guidance of in the band of 11% to 13% for the full year.

triggers.label: Inventory gains passed to channel
triggers.quote: the company passed on inventory gains to the distributors and channel partners

guidance.quote: EBITDA should be closer to our normal guidance of in the band of 11% to 13% for the full year.
we see 11% to 13% kind of operating margin and 12% to 15% kind of a volume growth.
it will be in the range of INR200 crores, which includes capex to maintain for our existing plant

guidance.value: INR20-25 crores quarterly in Q2/Q3 FY27
guidance.quote: At around INR20 crores, INR25 crores, we will hit that breakeven mark.

guidance.value: reduce by another 10-15 days by FY27 end
guidance.quote: our endeavor is to bring this further down b y another 10 days to 15 days by the end of this financial year.

prior_guidance_check.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR110 crores, an exceptional growth of 100% Y -o-Y, while margins stood at 13%

red_flags.label: April destocking and inventory gains passed on
red_flags.quote: So our channel partners had inventory. And in April, they have also done destocking.

red_flags.label: Bathware still loss-making
red_flags.quote: Revenue is INR16 crores and loss is INR5 crores for this quarter.

evasions.topic: Inventory gain/loss quantum in Q4 and Q1 margin
evasions.quote: So in Q4, inventory gain was, I would say, close to zero
Like I said, I think competitive intensity has reduced from a point of view that consolidation has happened.
